sentences.ko: 아니 뭐, 어차피 그날은 수업마다 코스튬 입고 가야 되거든. 그러니까 뭐.
sentences.text: I mean, I have to wear a costume to all my classes that day anyway, so.

alts.text: I gotta wear a costume to class that day anyway, so.
In any case, I am required to wear a costume to all of my classes that day.

sentences.note: **anyway, so** 로 말끝을 흐리면 '그러니까 별 상관없어' 라는 뜻이 됩니다. 이유를 대고 결론은 말하지 않고 넘길 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아니, 나를 직접 만나 보면 또 모르지.
sentences.text: I mean, maybe if they met me in person.

alts.text: Maybe if they actually met me, though.
Perhaps it would be different if they were to meet me in person.

sentences.note: **in person** 은 '직접 만나서, 얼굴 보고' 라는 뜻입니다. 전화나 글로는 안 되는데 만나 보면 다를 거라고 말할 때 씁니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 아까 잘 된 거 더 남은 거 있어?
sentences.text: Are there any more from the good batch?

alts.text: Got any more of the good ones?
Would there be any more left from the good batch?

sentences.note: **batch** 는 쿠키나 빵을 한 번에 구워 낸 한 판입니다. 여러 번 만들었는데 그중 잘 된 쪽을 더 달라고 할 때 **the good batch** 라고 합니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.text: I wish you a long and happy marriage.

alts.text: Here's to a long, happy marriage!
May you both have a long and happy marriage.

sentences.note: 결혼식 축사나 카드에 쓰는 말입니다. **I wish you** 뒤에 바라는 것을 붙이면 축하 인사가 됩니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.ko: 회사에서 좀 멀긴 한데, 뭐, 출퇴근하면서 이것저것 많이 할 수 있을 거야.
sentences.text: I mean, it's it's kind of far from work, but uh you know, I'll get so much done on the commute.

alts.text: Work's kinda far, but hey, I'll get a ton done on the way.
Although it is rather far from my workplace, I will be able to accomplish a great deal during my commute.

sentences.note: **kind of far** 는 '좀 멀다'를 부드럽게 말하는 표현이고, **get so much done** 은 '일을 많이 해치우다'라는 뜻이에요. 집이 멀어진 걸 좋게 포장하며 스스로 위로할 때 딱 맞는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 5 | Friends

sentences.ko: 그래서, 지금까지 어떻게 됐는지 좀 알려 줄래?
sentences.text: So, why don't you get me up to speed?

alts.text: Could you please bring me up to date on the situation?

sentences.note: **get me up to speed** 는 자리를 비웠거나 늦게 합류했을 때 '그동안 무슨 일 있었는지 알려 줘'라는 말이에요. 회의에 늦게 들어갔을 때나 휴가 다녀와서 동료에게 쓰기 좋습니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones That Make You Laugh: Part 3 | Friends

sentences.text: And I've had my share of bad reviews.

alts.text: Trust me, I've gotten plenty of bad reviews too.
I, too, have received a fair number of negative reviews.

sentences.note: **had my share of** 는 '나도 겪을 만큼 겪었다'는 뜻이에요. 힘들어하는 사람에게 '나도 그런 적 많아'라며 위로할 때 씁니다. 예를 들어 I've had my share of bad days 처럼요.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 8 | Friends

sentences.ko: 누구는 여자들이랑 겨뤄 보는 게 좀 겁나나 보네?
sentences.text: Somebody's afraid of a little competition with the ladies.

alts.text: Scared of a little competition from the girls, huh?
It appears that someone is afraid of competing with the women.

sentences.note: **Somebody's afraid of** 는 상대를 직접 가리키지 않고 '누군가'라고 돌려서 놀리는 말투예요. 친구가 시합이나 내기를 피할 때 장난스럽게 **a little competition** 과 함께 쓰면 딱입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 10 | Friends

sentences.ko: 너희 이거 알고 있었으면서 우리한테 말 안 했구나.
sentences.text: You guys knew about this and you didn't tell us.

alts.text: Wait, you knew and didn't say anything?
All of you were aware of this, yet you did not inform us.

sentences.note: **knew about this** 뒤에 **and you didn't tell us** 를 그대로 이어 붙이면 '알면서 말을 안 했다'는 서운함이 그대로 묻어나요. 친구들끼리 나만 몰랐던 소식을 뒤늦게 알았을 때 쓰는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: The Ones with the Whole Gang from Season 3 | Friends
